defs: def row($coll; $key; $id): .config[$coll][] | select(.[$key] == $id); def source_of($trigger): row("event_sources"; "event_source_id"; (row("triggers"; "trigger_id"; $trigger) | .source.event_source_id)); def workspace($binding; $collection; $prompt): . as $d | row("callback_bindings"; "binding_id"; $binding) as $b | $d | row("event_sources"; "event_source_id"; $b.event_source_id) | .source_collection == $collection and ($d.assets[$prompt] | (contains("make worktree BRANCH=") | not) and (contains("Do not run `git commit`") or contains("Do not run git commit")));

jq.name: the pack keeps its categories and worktree-sized packages
jq.expr: (.scenario.expect.prompt_tool_contracts | length) == 6 and (.scenario.expect.result_documents | length) == 6 and (.scenario.default_prompt | contains("one shared branch and worktree")) and .scenario.seed.fields.area_count == "auto" and .scenario.seed.fields.history_depth == "250" and (.config.tasks | length) == 8 and ([.config.triggers[] | select(.trigger_id == "maintenance-execute-skip")] | length) == 1

jq.name: publish opens one normal PR, bounds review rounds and uses the graph run flags
jq.expr: .assets["tasks/maintenance_publish_task/prompt.md"] | contains("one normal, non-draft PR") and contains("Bound this at two full review rounds") and (contains("make worktree BRANCH=") | not) and (test("--repo[ =]") | not) and contains("graph run code_review --field repository=")

jq.name: the execute workspace callback is bound and the worker may not commit
